# Codex Trajectory v0.3.2

This patch release makes Stop and quota-triggered auto-stop suitable for unattended Codex tasks, including on Windows.

- Replace the standard Apps follow-up message with an app-private direct-stop action that pauses an active Goal and interrupts the bound App Server turn.
- Never open the “Send follow-up prompt?” confirmation or place a stop request in the steering queue.
- Fail closed when experimental loopback CDP is unavailable: manual and automatic controls remain disabled with an explicit setup message instead of reporting a queued request as stopped.
- Resolve a missing active turn and rebind one rejected stale turn before retrying the bounded stop sequence.
- Keep the direct-stop action hidden from the model and reject arbitrary prompts, extra fields, unbounded identifiers, invalid thresholds, and unsupported locales.
- Add Windows PowerShell relaunch guidance alongside macOS instructions for enabling the loopback debugging port.
- Update the English and Chinese READMEs, plugin guide, Skill, interface reference, privacy policy, security model, and changelog to describe the direct-only stop behavior.

After installing or upgrading, open a new Codex task so the updated private app tool and viewer are loaded. Direct Stop remains disabled until you explicitly enable the experimental loopback CDP setting.
